reviewRole: Data/runner Builder numerical review, not independent source-code authorship review
scope: Lightweight recomputation from completed actual receipt and frozen reviewed truth; no repeated inference or full contract replay
reviewFormatStudy: M3Q, unchanged generic review format applied to new M3R sources and hashes

data.sourceRecordsBreakdown: 150 camera PNG + 59 labels + 3 reused pinned metadata files

numericalRecomputation.method: Separate manual normalized-box IoU/rival-margin join, without importing the production scorer; all A/B/S aggregate fields agree exactly

candidateUnreviewedEvent.classification: Unreviewed; not TP, FP or TN

numericalRecomputation.latencyPercentileMethod: Nearest rank, ceil(N*p/100)-1, matching the frozen scorer; interpolation is a different convention
numericalRecomputation.latencyScope: Actual per-frame detector observation + staging + native/working preparation + shared camera + required measurement/overlay; offline harness, not UI or realtime latency

disposition: NOT_READY: no measured reviewed-target recall gain. Preserve actual failures and unreviewed warning separately; do not promote candidate or infer metres. Zero observed FP on 28 selected negatives is not universal precision or safety acceptance.
